**Average (median) home price in California (2024)**  
- **Median value:** ≈ $800 000–$850 000  
- **Source:** Zillow Research – “California Home Value Index” (latest update 2024‑Q2)  

> *Note:* The median is often used as the “average” price in real‑estate reports because it represents the middle value of all listings. The actual arithmetic mean is slightly higher (≈ $860 000) due to a few very expensive properties, but the median gives a more realistic picture of typical home prices in the state.
